svg.title: A739 owner payment and receipt flow
svg.desc: Four scenarios: counter payment, three table payers, settling edit, later full invoice. Static target with fiscal dependency. Technical defaults remain proposed.

g.text: Tick before Card to request the slip.
Print and Email are separate presses.
Neither takes payment or opens drawer.
F2 already issued; F3 is required.
Print on Office · needs fiscal work
No delayed F2 issue. No second charge.
This preview does not enable F1 / F3.
EUR30 · Three card parts of EUR10
Guest 3 line is the final result.
Earlier copies keep EUR20 and EUR10.
How will the next guest pay?
Cash EUR10 settles this EUR10 balance.
Ask on this handheld or counter now
The requested card slip still stands.
Table remains open. Finish is separate.
Choosing None does not cancel a slip.
Successful save settles the EUR10 bill.
No Cash or Card. No new slip.
Choose the document for this edit.
Nothing inherited from the EUR10 payer.
Ask the active editor, including office.
No one answers: policy not yet agreed.
The guest now asks for a full invoice.
Print a copy on Bar receipt
Copying cannot create a full invoice.
Target preview · not an available action
New F3 linked to S/318 is required.
The original F2 is never rewritten.
Core writer exists; public flow is missing.
Owner lands the separate fiscal build.
No delay to the earlier F2 issuance.
Later Print / Email need the new record.
Lost reply: recover the same request.
EUR10 card on EUR30 · EUR20 left
Target · Disabled · No extra Waitron slip
Requested EUR10 slip keeps EUR20 left.
Never guess that it has no paper.
Cash: EUR10 of EUR30, EUR20 left; no slip.
Target: prove adapter and reader control.
